author: Vior_
body:
IGN: Vior_
Discord( Name#): Vior#7403
Timezone: EST
Any previous Ref experience?: I have none
Why would you like to join the referee team: I would like experience as an avicus staff member before I apply for mod next opening, and It seems like a good opportunity to get to know people more. If I am not playing in the tournament I will be glad to still be able to help out.
Are you able to commit to Saturday Tournaments, and occasionally event staff meetings?: I will most likely be able too, especially during the summer. Event staff meetings will work for me.
A paragraph or two to tell us something about yourself: I have been playing on advicus for 4 years including Mczone, and have not had the opportunity to play the role as staff. I am starting to really get into the community more, and think this would be great for me.
Anything else?: Thank you <3.
